units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:2">B. Mets. X, 2</cite> <he>הע׳</he> the owner of the upper story, v. <cite ref="M02094"><he>מַעֲזִיבָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 2:1:13">Y. Bicc. II, 64ᵈ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="E00789"><he>הקדש</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 26:13">Deut. XXVI, 13</cite>) <he>הקודש הע׳ במשמע</he> if refers to the sacred matter mentioned above (first-fruits, ib. 2, sq.).

Maasr. V, 8 זרע לוף הע׳ the seed- capsules on the tops of lof (v. לוֹף), expl. Y. ib. 52ᵃ bot., v. סָלַל I; a. fr.—Fem. עֶלְיוֹנָה. Tanḥ. Tsav 1 (play on עוֹלָה) שהיא ע׳ וכ׳ it is the highest of all sacrifices.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 64a:2">B. Bath. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>דיוטא הע׳</he> the upper story.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 77b:6">B. Mets. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>יד לוקח על הע׳</he> the buyer is at an advantage, has the choice between annulling and insisting on the bargain, opp. <he>על התחתונה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00093"><he>יָד</he></cite>.—

Lev. R. s. 24, beg. (ref. to Ps. XCII, 9) לעולם ידך בע׳ thy power is always uppermost, i.e. is always submitted to, whether thou blessest or punishest; Yalk. Ps. 843 על הע׳; Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ על הע׳, לע׳; a. fr.—Pl. עֶלְיוֹנִים, עֶלְיוֹנִין; f. עֶלְיוֹנוֹת. Ib. 14ᵃ top המים הע׳ the waters from above the earth; a. fr.—Esp. עליונים heavenly creatures, angels.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>בראשון ברא מן הע׳ וכ׳</he> on the first he created heavenly and earthly things &c.; <he>בראו מן הע׳ וכ׳</he> he created man so as to make him partake of the nature of the upper creatures and of that of the lower; a. fr.
